I, John Anthony Emmanuel Amarathunga, Minister of Lands, herebydeclare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land AcquisitionAct, that the land described below is needed for a public purposeand will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land called ‘‘Kongahamula Watta’’ in total extentof about 0.0379 Hectare depicted as Lot A in Advance Tracing No.KU/MLL/2015/259 - A and dated 23.11.2015 prepared by theSurveyor General, situated in the Village of Idangapola in Narampola,Grama Niladhari Division No. 725, in Mahagalboda Megoda Korale(South) Minor Division in the Divisional Secretaries Division ofMallawapitya in Kurunegala District, North Western Province andbounded as follows.
01. Lot ‘‘A’’ – Kongahamula Watta – Extent: 0.0379 HectareNorth: Road of Road Development Authority and Deduru Oya;East: Deduru Oya and Land claimed by National Water Supply and

Drainage Board; South: Land claimed by National Water Supply andDrainage Board and Remaining portion of this land claimed byKristhogu Baduge Karunarathne; West: Remaining portion of thisland claimed by Kristhogu Baduge Karunarathne and road of RoadDevelopment Authority.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/9/2015/WS/28.Ministry of Lands,"Mihikatha Medura",No. 1200/6,Rajamalwaththa Road,Battaramulla.13th February, 2017
